A '''''Cumulus''-class Corsair''' was owned by [[Pirate King]] [[Gorian Shard]] and his [[Gorian Shard's pirate crew|pirate crew]] around [[9 ABY]]. It was involved in a [[dogfight in the Nevarro system]], and later launched the [[Pirate siege on Nevarro]] itself, during which it was destroyed by the Mandalorians.

==Description==
Shard's pirate Corsair used deflector shields; but like the rest, those were not designed to face military grade weaponry. It also had eight engines to ensure sublight propulsion, as well as a hyperdrive for interstellar travel. Finally, it had communications equipment. A recognizable features of this ship was its anvil-shaped prow.<ref name="Chapter 21" />
[[File:GorianShardCorsairBridge-TMCh17.png|thumb|300px|left|Gorian Shard commanded his forces from the center of the bridge.]]
The Corsair was equipped with four Quad Laser Cannons on its back, two on each side, to repel fighters and patrol ships from local defense. In addition, it featured fourteen ventral gunwales to shoot at ground targets with unguided missiles in order to spread fear and chaos. However, those gunwales were unable to track enemy fighters, as shown during the siege on Nevarro.<ref name="Chapter 21" />

Shard's pirate Corsair could deploy up to a dozen of [[Cumulus-class snub fighter]]s from its dorsal hangar to pursuit enemy vessel or to defend their carrier. Though agile and equipped with 4 laser cannons, those fighters, just like the Cumulus class, were more designed for piracy and attacking lightly defended cargo than for real combat, as they were easily shot down by military-grade starfighter like [[Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze's Gauntlet starfighter]].<ref name="Chapter 21" /> The Corsair was also the base of operations for [[Vane's Snub Fighter squadron]]. 

==History==
Gorian Shard's pirate Corsair participated in the [[dogfight in the Nevarro system]]<ref name="Chapter 17" /> and served as Shard's primary vessel during his invasion of the planet following an encounter between the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]], [[Nevarro]]'s [[High Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]], and a group of pirates led by Gorian Shard's second-in-command, [[Vane]]. After Shard called Karga to demand his surrender, the ship bombarded the city of Nevarro with missiles in order to spread fear and force the civilian population to flee.<ref name="Chapter 21" />

[[File:CorsairDown-TMch21.png|thumb|300px|left|Shard's Corsair crashed on the outskirts of Nevarro City.]]
When the Mandalorians launched their counter-offensive, the [[starship]] immediately sustained heavy damages, as its shields and its armament proved unable to counter the military-grade fighter used by Din Djarin and Bo-Katan. Quickly, the shields were disabled and there was only one engine left functioning. On Shard's orders, the ship fired its gunwales at will on the city, hoping to eliminate the Mandalorian ground forces, and the civilian population in a last act of defiance, but the Mandalorian fighters destroyed the last engine, and the ship crashed just outside the city, killing all its crew, including Gorian Shard.<ref name="Chapter 21" />
